# Dr. Ford

> Dr. Ford is Daniel Robert Ford, a Nashville record producer who specializes in country music. Songwriters send him a voice memo; real Nashville session musicians play the song, and he produces, mixes and masters it into a finished record. Most clients work with him remotely from anywhere in the world.

Key facts:

- Full name: Daniel Robert Ford. Known as "Dr. Ford" (from his initials). Business name: Dr. Ford Productions.
- Based in Nashville, Tennessee. Making records since 1998; opened Dr. Ford Productions in 2009; back in Nashville since 2017.
- 9 #1 records with clients, 13 client awards, 180+ five-star reviews.
- Voting member of the Recording Academy. Graduate of Musicians Institute (Hollywood). SoundBetter Premium Pro since November 2019.
- No AI-generated music: every note is played by real Nashville musicians.
- Pricing: production, mixing and mastering from $2,500 per song. Albums and catalogs are custom programs. Gift certificates: mastering $125, mix and master $450, The First Song Experience $2,500.
- How it works: 1) send a voice memo, 2) consultation, 3) Nashville players track the song and the client gets video from the session, 4) Daniel mixes and masters it, ready for release.
- Contact: the consultation form at https://www.drford.com/#consult
